name: The Communist Manifesto ~ A Visual Novel
source: The visual novel adaptation of The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. Experience the Manifesto in a conversational style for the first time and fully customize your reading.
translation: 卡尔·马克思和弗里德里希·恩格斯根据《共产党宣言》改编的视觉小说。首次以对话方式体验宣言并完全定制你的阅读方式。
